body:
Founder real-time: 'can we make the carepyre encryption warning a little less scary? it takes over the full screen can you make it more like a flash message at the top?' Moved #unencrypted-banner out of the mail page's own inline flow (where it wrapped tall on narrow viewports and used hard-coded dark-red/pink colors clashing with the app's light theme) to a slim strip directly under the header, visible on any page. Pure markup/CSS change -- loadEncryptionStatus() already ran once at app-shell init, so no JS change needed. node --check clean.

⚓ ☃
title: Encryption warning restyled as a slim top-of-app flash message, not a full-screen-feeling dark-red card
